style_authority.note: Reads the component as a calm, high-frequency web operations context panel and makes direct control, immediate re-grab, stable task context, and legible snap state the governing policy.

reference_selection.note: Applies motion quality, interaction physics, gesture lifecycle, transform ownership, presentation-value interruption, accessibility, performance tracing, responsive validation, and device evidence.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Keeps causal pointer feedback, 1:1 displacement, settle, and non-spatial state feedback while rejecting transition-all, layout animation, whole-sheet scale, input lockout, decorative bounce, remounting, and parallax.

evidence_level.note: Labels the critique as static-source only and expressly avoids claiming measured latency, frame rate, cascade behavior, touch conflict, responsive behavior, or physical-device results.

verified_boundary.note: Separates source-visible control flow, property writes, timing, and missing branches from unverified geometry, animation priority, performance cost, gesture arbitration, external accessibility code, browsers, and devices.

design_moves.note: Provides exactly eight concrete moves covering handle feedback, active-pointer capture, grab-offset 1:1 transform tracking, presentation-value and velocity interruption, measured CSS-px/s release velocity as settle initial velocity, bounded authorized projection, midpoint hysteresis, rubber-band resistance, and Reduced Motion.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and motion-specific, with exactly five blocking findings, eight design moves, a decisive validation plan, and 141 logical lines within the 150-line cap.
